pooled_hartung_knapp.why_it_is_shown: Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.5 recommends Hartung-Knapp where k is small. Shown ALONGSIDE the unadjusted interval, not instead of it. A FLOOR OF 1 is applied to the variance-inflation factor so the adjustment can never NARROW the interval below the unadjusted one.

heterogeneity.DIRECTION_TEST: NOT APPLICABLE -- I-squared is 0.0%, below the threshold at which the direction test is informative. The trials are consistent with a common effect and no heterogeneity caution is warranted. Applying one here would manufacture doubt the data do not support, which is the mirror failure of ignoring heterogeneity that matters.
heterogeneity.how_to_read_this_at_low_k: At k=2 or k=3 these statistics are weak evidence about consistency in EITHER direction. A low value means the estimates are CONSISTENT WITH a common effect, not that one is demonstrated.
heterogeneity.tau2_estimator: REML -- copied from this block's declared `estimator`, which is the authoritative record of how the pool was computed. NOT inferred: an object that declared no estimator would be left undeclared here, because the absence is itself the finding.
heterogeneity.i2_definition: UNDECIDABLE from this object. I-squared is 0 and Q is below the degrees of freedom, where the Higgins form is negative-and-clamped and the REML/metafor form is exactly zero -- BOTH DEFINITIONS GIVE 0 and nothing here distinguishes them. Recorded as undecidable rather than guessed.

primary.the_fourth_trial_EXCLUDED_and_why: NCT04198571 IS SEEDED ON THIS PAGE AND IS NOT IN THIS POOL. Two reasons, either sufficient. FIRST, its condition is 'Community Acquired Pneumonia; Complicated Skin and Soft tissue' -- two indications under one registration. SECOND AND DECISIVE, its posted primary is not a randomised comparison at all: the two groups are 'Participants With CAP' (151/185) and 'Participants With cSSTI' (118/132), which is a DESCRIPTIVE SPLIT BY INDICATION, not an intervention against a comparator. There is no ceftriaxone arm to contrast. It is excluded and the exclusion is stated rather than left to inference.
primary.why_the_other_three_cohere: All three randomise ceftaroline fosamil against intravenous ceftriaxone in bacterial pneumonia and register CLINICAL CURE AT TEST-OF-CURE as the primary. Same intervention, same comparator, same outcome, same infection -- the four limbs the eleven 2026-08-18 closures failed.

published_synthesis_comparison.what_is_owed: No published meta-analysis or regulatory review pooling the FOCUS programme has been read. These are registration trials, so an FDA or EMA review almost certainly pools them and would be a STRONGER comparator than a journal synthesis: it has access to data no journal reviewer holds. Any DIVERGENCE from it would be more informative than agreement.

primary.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial is free of bias -- NO RISK-OF-BIAS ASSESSMENT IS RECORDED, and a pooled estimate without one is arithmetic, not a graded finding. NOT superiority: these are non-inferiority trials against an active comparator, and a risk ratio near 1 is the EXPECTED result of a successful one rather than evidence of equivalence. NOT anything about the fourth seeded trial, which is excluded above. NOT agreement with any published synthesis; none has been read.

house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.estimator: REML with Hartung-Knapp, t on k-1 = 2 degree(s) of freedom (t = 4.3027)
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED: The published point is 1.1049 and the house-rule point is 1.1048. THE NUMBER A READER REMEMBERS DOES NOT MOVE; what differs is the precision claim. That is why nothing downstream catches this -- every memorable quantity survives.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.variance_inflation_floor: A FLOOR OF 1 IS APPLIED TO THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR so the adjustment can never NARROW an interval below the unadjusted one. That guard is the recognised modification for exactly this instability, and its existence is evidence the small-k behaviour is a KNOWN problem with KNOWN handling rather than a novel judgement.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.no_rule_is_decided_here: The house rule is REML with Hartung-Knapp below k=10, settled days ago. Whether it means ALWAYS or WITH A FLOOR AT k=3 is a decision about this corpus, not a computation, and it has been referred rather than taken. BOTH INTERVALS STAND ON THIS PAGE UNTIL IT IS MADE. Nothing is unpublished and no reader is left with only the narrower one.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.what_this_means_for_this_pool: THE PUBLISHED INTERVAL EXCLUDES 1 AND THE HOUSE-RULE INTERVAL CROSSES IT. A SIGNIFICANCE VERDICT TURNS ON THE INTERVAL METHOD ALONE. A reader shown only the published interval has been told something firmer than the evidence supports; a reader shown only the wider one loses that the contributing trials agree. BOTH ARE HERE.

POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.a_this_pool_crosses_analysis_populations: THE ANALYSIS POPULATION IS PART OF THE ESTIMAND AND THIS POOL CROSSES IT. Read from the registrations on 2026-08-21: NCT00509106 registers 'Clinical Cure Rate for Ceftaroline Compared to That for Ceftriaxone at the Test of Cure (TOC) in the Modified ' (population: MITTE); NCT00621504 registers 'Clinical Cure Rate at Test-of-Cure (TOC) in the Modified Intent-to-Treat Efficacy (MITTE) Populations' (population: MITTE); NCT01371838 registers 'Clinical Cure Rate for Ceftaroline Compared to That for Ceftriaxone at Test of Cure (TOC) in CE Population' (population: CE). The populations pooled are CE and MITTE.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.b_why_that_matters: A CLINICALLY EVALUABLE population EXCLUDES protocol violators and indeterminate responses, and microbiologically-defined populations exclude patients without a qualifying pathogen. Those are SELECTED SUBSETS of the modified intent-to-treat population and systematically yield HIGHER cure rates. A cure-rate ratio computed in one is not an estimate of the same quantity as one computed in another, so this pooled value depends on which trial registered which population.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.c_what_is_not_claimed: NOT that the arithmetic is wrong. NOT that the direction would reverse -- that would need the per-population counts and is NOT established. And NOT that these are non-inferiority trials: THE REGISTRATIONS FETCHED DO NOT USE THAT WORD, so the design question is unresolved from the registry rather than assumed.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.a_no_published_pool_of_these_three_trial: THIS SCREEN FOUND NO PUBLISHED SYNTHESIS POOLING THESE THREE TRIALS. The nearest relevant record is a NETWORK meta-analysis across many community-acquired pneumonia regimens (PMID 34540732), which answers a different question from a ceftaroline-versus-ceftriaxone pool. 42 records matched, 42 read, 18 flagged by title, ONE appraised; the rest were NOT READ, so absence here is absence FROM THIS SCREEN and not from the literature.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.b_the_pool_crosses_an_analysis_populatio: Two contributing trials register the primary in the MITTE population and one in the CE population. CE excludes protocol violators and indeterminate responses and systematically yields higher cure rates, so this ratio is assembled across quantities that are not the same quantity. GRADE indirectness is downgraded for it.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.c_the_conclusion_survives_the_small_samp: Unlike tigecycline, ceftaroline's result holds under adjustment: the Hartung-Knapp interval at k = 3 is 1.0356 to 1.1787 on t = 4.3027 with 2 df, and it still excludes no difference. Recorded because the two topics separate on exactly this.

r_output._what_this_is: Console output of the fit as printed. NOT re-typed.
r_output.call: rma(yi = yi, sei = sei, method = "REML") and the knha fit
r_output.inputs_derivation: yi = log(point); sei = (log(ci_high) - log(ci_low)) / (2 * 1.959964), from this object's own per_trial rows.
r_output.interval_method: REML with the unadjusted Wald interval, and the same fit under Hartung-Knapp beside it. THE HOUSE INTERVAL FLOORS THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR AT max(1, SE_knha/SE_unadjusted); metafor's raw unfloored value is printed separately and flagged where it is narrower than the unadjusted interval.
r_output.why_this_was_re_run: THE PREVIOUS STORED OUTPUT LABELLED metafor's RAW knha INTERVAL 'Hartung-Knapp' with no qualifier. On this topic that is a value the house rule does not produce, quoted verbatim as our engine's word. On nirsevimab-infant-rsv-review the difference was conclusion-changing: the raw interval 0.1233 to 0.5505 EXCLUDES no effect and the stored house interval 0.0209 to 3.2477 INCLUDES it.

steps.reason: All three results are SOME_CONCERNS: non-uniform masking (one trial's care provider unmasked) on an assessed cure endpoint, with D2 and D3 NO_INFORMATION.
The stored refit gives tau^2 EXACTLY ZERO, Q 0.6553 on 2 df, p = 0.7206, I-squared 0.00%. The three trials agree.

THE POOL CROSSES AN ANALYSIS-POPULATION BOUNDARY: two trials register the primary in MITTE and one in CE. CE excludes protocol violators and indeterminate responses and systematically yields higher cure rates, so the pooled ratio is assembled across quantities that are not the same quantity.
k = 3 and the effect is consistent. The Hartung-Knapp interval, 1.0356 to 1.1787 on t = 4.3027 with 2 df, STILL EXCLUDES no difference, so the conclusion survives the small-k adjustment.

published_comparison.THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2: THIS SCREEN FOUND NO PUBLISHED SYNTHESIS POOLING THESE THREE TRIALS. The nearest relevant record is a NETWORK meta-analysis across many community-acquired pneumonia regimens (PMID 34540732), which answers a different question from a ceftaroline-versus-ceftriaxone pool. 42 records matched, 42 read, 18 flagged by title, ONE appraised; the rest were NOT READ, so absence here is absence FROM THIS SCREEN and not from the literature. Two contributing trials register the primary in the MITTE population and one in the CE population. CE excludes protocol violators and indeterminate responses and systematically yields higher cure rates, so this ratio is assembled across quantities that are not the same quantity. GRADE indirectness is downgraded for it. Unlike tigecycline, ceftaroline's result holds under adjustment: the Hartung-Knapp interval at k = 3 is 1.0356 to 1.1787 on t = 4.3027 with 2 df, and it still excludes no difference. Recorded because the two topics separate on exactly this.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In Ceftaroline fosamil versus ceftriaxone in bacterial pneumonia, what is the effect on versus intravenous ceftriaxone on clinical cure at test-of-cure?

It pools 3 randomised trials, against intravenous ceftriaxone.

The outcome pooled is clinical cure at test-of-cure.

Every count and denominator behind those estimates is read as follows. REGISTRY THROUGHOUT. Every count and denominator read from ClinicalTrials.gov posted results.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

bookkeeping_2026_08_21._what: The five reporting claims a PRISMA-2020 manuscript needs that are FETCHABLE rather than argued -- each derived from a field here, or stated as an honest absence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_limbs_this_review_refuses: Of the four properties this project requires of a completed topic, 4 are held (comparison denominator, grade per pool, model output verbatim, rob per result).
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.the_search_its_date_and_its_databases: PRIMARY TRIALS. NO BIBLIOGRAPHIC SEARCH FOR PRIMARY TRIALS WAS RUN. The 3 included trials were identified by reading named registrations on 2026-08-18. All FOUR seeded registrations read on 2026-08-18; three pooled, one excluded on the grounds stated in the analysis block. PUBLISHED SYNTHESES. PubMed E-utilities esearch + esummary, executed 2026-08-21. Query as executed: (ceftaroline[tiab]) AND (pneumonia[tiab] OR CABP[tiab] OR CAP[tiab]) AND (meta-analysis[pt] OR "systematic review"[pt] OR meta-analysis[tiab] OR "pooled"[tiab] OR FOCUS[tiab]). It matched 42 record(s), of which 42 were retrieved and 42 read; 1 appraised.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.whether_this_review_was_prospectively_re: NO PROSPERO REGISTRATION OR PROTOCOL RECORD IS HELD ON THIS OBJECT. That is not the same as knowing this review was not registered, and neither claim is made. It is recorded here as an absence so that a reader does not have to infer it from silence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.that_two_assessors_disagreed_and_where: Risk of bias was assessed independently a second time by GPT-5 Codex (openai family), via `codex exec`, blind to this assessment and given the same registry facts. 12 of 18 judgements -- 66.7%. Reported as DISAGREEMENT: agreement between two assessors given the same facts authenticates nothing. By domain: D1 3 of 3 disagree, D2 0 of 3 disagree, D3 0 of 3 disagree, D4 3 of 3 disagree, D5 3 of 3 disagree, OVERALL 3 of 3 disagree. Recounted after this review's D1 judgements moved: 9 of 18 judgements -- 50.0%.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_risk_of_bias_domains_drove_the_rat: Where a result is rated worse than LOW overall, the domain carrying that judgement is: D4 on 3 result(s), D5 on 3 result(s). The overall rating is the worst domain, so these are the domains that determine it.

why_the_question_is_open.draft: The evidence identified on this question is 3 randomised trials (NCT00509106, NCT00621504, NCT01371838), pooled here at 1.105 (95% CI 1.049 to 1.163) for clinical cure at test-of-cure. Certainty in that estimate is rated LOW, rated down for risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness and imprecision. What this estimate does not establish is recorded in full with the result in Results, and is not restated here.
